decisions_made.description: HALT the Prompt Manager phase because all required derivation inputs (pipeline-design.json + 3 upstream handoffs + _canon.md) are absent in the corpus-seed environment.
decisions_made.rationale: Kernel Rules 1-2 and §3 Pre-Flight: on 0 grep/file hits, HALT and request override — never invent. Fabricating a prompt library would violate Analytical Rigour + Source Integrity + Operational Boundaries directives.
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: No prompt library exists yet; downstream runtime-input-enrichment and prompt-invoking agents must not assume a populated prompts/ directory. Re-dispatch agent-12 after inputs materialize.

decisions_made.description: Emit an empty-but-schema-valid PromptManagerPayload rather than synthesizing plausible prompts from the skill manifest alone.
decisions_made.rationale: The skill manifest defines HOW to derive prompts; it is not itself the pipeline-design derivation surface. Deriving prompts from governance skills instead of the product's boundary/state-machine would produce a hallucinated library uncorrelated with any real product.
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: stats/tier_distribution all zero; consumers should treat this as a not-yet-run state.

surface_observations: Corpus-seed dispatch supplied the skill manifest + playbook only; the product-specific derivation surface (pipeline-design.json boundary + state-machine + bindings, plus 3 upstream handoffs and _canon.md) was not materialized.

The Manager's operation is deterministic over real inputs; with zero inputs the only correct output is a Spec-Gate HALT with an empty, schema-valid library — the tier framing, walkers, and Multiplier floor machinery had nothing valid to run against.
